## 3. Wire it up

Run `npx rr add socials`. Compose `socialsTables` into root schema. Bootstrap with `npx convex run internal.features.socials.mutations.seed '{"items":[{"platform":"github","url":"https://github.com/<you>","order":1,"visible":true,"featured":true,"sameAs":true,"relMe":true}]}'`. Wire `useQuery(api.features.socials.queries.listVisible)` into footer for entity-graph SEO.
